milestone_guidance: Event cursor is the last observed institution event sequence, not an event count. Projection health and freshness describe the read-only ledger response; CME and worker health use separate heartbeat signals. Grace execution status describes its execution registry and is separate from chat availability. Refresh reads use browser cache bypass; the displayed time is the source observation time. Healthy means the required ledger query succeeded; not initialized means PostgreSQL responded but required ledger tables are absent; unavailable means current state could not be confirmed. M3.1 identifies this dashboard milestone; roadmap progress, deployed release, and commissioning acceptance are tracked separately.
